name: Toggle / Editor Mode
description: Editor Mode product scenario for the Toggle component.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Choices in visual, keyboard and form order; missing items render an empty group.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable every control and exclude the group from FormData.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Visual axis; single radio mode supports both arrow pairs.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible group name when there is no visible heading.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Visible heading IDs that name this group.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Native FormData key; multiple selections produce repeated entries.

controls.name: form
controls.description: ID of an external form that owns the selection.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the selected enabled choice, or the first enabled choice, on mount.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each item; toggling preserves DOM and focus.

controls.name: type
controls.description: Legacy selection mode; new code uses SegmentedControl multiple.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Selected choices; single mode accepts at most one.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial choices, restored on form reset.
